title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1211: Big furball and grandstar (1)

section.p: Looking at Chen Yong’s figure as he entered Nanyuan, Su Yu had an expression of deep contemplation.
Everyone had arrived.
Apart from Su Yu, who was supposed to still be in the ancient city, everyone from the fifth principal’s line had arrived. This would be the greatest chance one could find to wipe out this line.
Sure, Wu Jia was still around. But she was only a Skysoar. Very few people would even remember her existence.

People like Hong Tan, Liu Wenyan, Su Yu, Chen Yong, Bai Feng, Xia Yunji, and a few others were the ones with the attention of the various realms. As for the others, or to be precise, as for Wu Jia, nobody cared about her.
As Su Yu at the city, the Titanic Strength Sect master sent him a voice transmission, “Profound Nine, when the battle breaks out, can we attack the multiple character faction?”
“Act as you wish.” Su Yu said, “I don’t represent the pavilion. This is my personal matter. It has nothing to do with the pavilion.”
The others rolled their eyes. In that case, why did he tell them to attack earlier?

As for Hong Tan’s attempt to spread the disassembly method, it wasn’t going smoothly. The myriad races seemed determined to fight it out if he persisted. Not even the arrival of those from the Zhu and Qin Families could change this.
Suddenly, intense heavenly source qi undulations erupted inside the city. A massive beam of light rose into the sky.
“Liu Wenyan is on the verge of breakthrough!”
Someone wondered, “Is he really going to step right into the ninth stage after entering the Sunmoon Realm?”
“If that happens, nobody can resist attacking anymore. We will have to attack as well. That’s too big of a threat to leave alone.”
It would be too terrifying if Liu Wenyan could really reach the ninth-stage Sunmoon Realm right away. Of course, most people believed that this wouldn’t happen. How could advancement be so simple?

Liu Wenyan had been stuck at the Mental Tempering Stage for decades. He had only reached the Skysoar Realm about a year and a half ago. Su Yu glanced at the city and noted that it would take Liu Wenyan about a day or two. There was no rush. Suddenly, he received a message from the third elder.
“Profound Nine, someone offered a very high price to kill Liu Wenyan, Hong Tan, and the others.”

The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion was still a big organization spread across the Myriad Realms. He had been happily using the pavilion as his tool, but evidently, someone else was trying to do the same as well.
“Did you accept the mission, Elder?”

“Yes. This is how the pavilion operates. When a mission is available and it is within our means to complete, we will take it.” The third elder explained, “We’re doing this for the sake of the pavilion’s reputation. The other party offered thirty drops of ninth-stage Sunmoon blood essence for this mission.”
The difference between the first and the ninth stages was massive.

The difference was likely larger than ten times in strength. In fact, ninth-stage Sunmoon blood essence was very rare. Even in the pavilion, blood essence of this level could only be traded for treasures, not heavenly hunt points.
The thirty drops offered could only be obtained by slaying at least three ninth-stage Sunmoons. That was a very large offer.

Su Yu guessed that this was most likely a mission issued by the traitor Invincible. After all, this was a price even regular Pseudo Invincibles wouldn’t be able to afford. There was also the possibility that this was a mission issued by the myriad races.
“Has the payment been collected?”
The pavilion would always collect the payment before carrying out the mission.
“Not yet. This isn’t all. The same customer has made a second request as well.”

Su Yu concluded that this was probably not a prominent customer or a customer he had acquired as he would have been notified otherwise. The mission had likely been issued to them through the headquarters.
“What is the second request?”
“Killing Xia Xiao’er.”

A realization dawned on Su Yu. Considering the targets of the mission, this customer was most certainly the traitor Invincible. The traitor was aware that the Xia Family was trying to lure him out. Thus, he had decided to have the pavilion test the waters for him.

Su Yu said, “The Xia Family is probably hiding a combatant capable of fighting Invincibles around. It might be the tri-life body of an Invincible or a Pseudo Invincible. The purpose of the second request is obvious. The traitor is trying to use us to expose the Xia Family’s trump card. Did the pavilion really accept it?”
“Yes.” After a slight hesitation, the third elder said, “The price offered is too high to refuse. And we are only required to deploy two Pseudo Invincibles for the price of one carrier treasure.”
Su Yu was shocked. That was indeed a very good price. This was not a temptation Pseudo Invincibles could refuse.
“Elder, this is too dangerous. Also, why are you telling me this? What is your plan?”

Why was the elder telling him if the two missions had already been accepted? He was well aware that the elders were merely using him as a distraction to grab everyone’s attention. They had their own agenda to pursue.

And now, a carrier treasure had been offered. Clearly, the third elder had been moved by this offer. The traitor was surprisingly generous. A carrier treasure and thirty drops of ninth-stage Sunmoon blood essence had been offered for the lives of Liu Wenyan, his group, and Marquis Xia.
And it was likely that these missions weren’t even issued to be completed successfully. Rather, the traitor only wanted someone to expose the Xia Family’s trump card.

It wasn’t even surprising that the pavilion would be tempted by the price offered. The deployment of two Pseudo Invincibles for one carrier treasure. This wouldn’t even necessarily be that dangerous a mission. Even if the Xia Family revealed someone capable of fighting Invincibles, the Yellow Department head was here. Thus, the elders had nothing to fear.
Additionally, the traitor Invincible might also make a move after the trump card of Xia Family was exposed.

The third elder said, “You’re good at negotiations. The pavilion is of the opinion that these missions are still quite dangerous. It will be better for us to join hands with the divines and devils. Naturally, we don’t have to let them know about our missions.”

In short, the pavilion intended to get the myriad races to work for free. The divines and devils would probably be more than happy to accept the proposal of cooperation. Thus, they wouldn’t care if the pavilion was being paid for this.
Su Yu cursed inwardly. How was he an expert negotiator? Was the pavilion trying to keep him busy after noticing how easily he had handled the Myriad Race Cult?
“Elder, will the pavilion really receive the carrier treasure?”
“I think so. The customer offered to pay the blood essence first. The carrier treasure will be paid after mission completion.”
Su Yu said, “Isn’t that against our rules? Will the customer really pay after the mission?”
“That’s why we have yet to agree. We’re waiting for further replies from the customer.”
“Do we know who the customer is? The mission has to be issued through an index copy, right?”
“We don’t. That index copy used to belong to a Sunmoon. It is probably still in the hands of that Sunmoon. We believe the Sunmoon is merely an intermediary.”

Su Yu had nothing else to ask. The pavilion had essentially accepted the mission. As long as the payment was made, the mission would be carried out. One carrier treasure and thirty drops of ninth-stage Sunmoon blood essence were enough to hire two Pseudo Invincibles.

As for the danger associated with the mission, the two Pseudo Invincibles had probably taken the risk into consideration as well. And they were expecting him to fool the divines and devils into helping them with the mission? What was the third elder planning?

The third elder said, “Profound Nine, you will be negotiating with the divines and devils. Since you’re an ancient city resident, we understand the difficult position you’re in. Apart from the negotiation, you don’t have to do anything else.”

In short, they were removing his authority momentarily lest he messed with the completion of the new mission. That was understandable. He had removed almost all the small fries they wanted to remove and exposed almost all the hidden experts they wanted to expose.

Since he was no longer of much use to them, it was natural for them to remove his authority over so many Sunmoons. After all, those Sunmoons were still very useful for the pavilion. With several late-stage Sunmoons in the group, they could handle peak Sunmoons or even some of the weaker Pseudo Invincibles.

They certainly wouldn’t allow Su Yu to remain in control of such a powerful group of individuals. They were also wary of his bias toward the multiple character faction. This would be the perfect reason for them to kick him out from their subsequent operations.
“They’re basically discarding the worker after the work is done.”

Su Yu cursed inwardly. Sure enough, these pavilion members couldn’t be counted on. Now that he was no longer that useful, they had decided to kick him out. His decision to help Chen Yong previously had probably helped expedite this decision.
Of course, it was unlikely that they were suspecting his allegiance or they wouldn’t even inform him of the new mission. This was merely meant as a small warning that he should withdraw now.
“I understand. But Elder, everyone knows the pavilion very well. If we appear too enthusiastic, they will be able to guess that we must have received a new mission.”

The third elder replied, “This doesn’t matter they will benefit from this as well. Everyone is waiting to see the Xia Family’s trump card. They have only been holding back due to a lack of opportunity to act. And we will provide them with this opportunity.”
There was no fear that the others would know that they were only doing this for a mission. The divines and devils would agree as long as their benefits aligned.
“I understand. But Elder, the divines and devils don’t like me that much. If I go alone, I might end up killed. Can I get First Profound Elder to go with me?”

“Of course. In fact, Titanic Strength and Earthfire will both be going with you as well. Profound Nine, I hope you will understand why we’re doing this. We don’t want to place you in a difficult situation. We understand that you won’t want to offend Su Yu.”
“Thank you, Elder. I appreciate what the pavilion is doing for me.”

Su Yu did not bother asking why was he the one negotiating with the divines and devils instead of the elders. This was how the big shots would always act. The small fries would start the initial negotiations and establish a general framework. The big shots only needed to step forth in the end to seal the deal.
In any case, it was clear that the pavilion would join up with the myriad races soon.
Su Yu sighed inwardly. Would this really happen?
Quite a lot of experts had arrived. The divines, devils, dragons, immortals, nethers, primordial giants, five elementals, apes, and other powerful races had deployed their Pseudo Invincibles here.
All in all, the myriad races had twelve Pseudo Invincibles here. Coupled with the two from the pavilion, they would be able to muster a force of fourteen Pseudo Invincibles.

The various forces had yet to reach an understanding. That was why they seemed helpless against the Xia Family. Everyone was wary of the possible trump card the Xia Family was hiding and nobody wanted to take the lead.
With the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion offering to help, it was likely that a temporary alliance would be formed successfully. Could Wan Tiansheng even handle so many experts?
Su Yu felt his head aching. Wan Tiansheng’s target was clearly the traitor. Meanwhile, Marquis Xia and Qin Hao were both only eighth-stage Sunmoons. Only Zhu Tiandao was a ninth-stage Sunmoon.
But this was far from enough to handle so many Pseudo Invincibles. Would this crisis end with the destruction of the Xia Family?
Wan Tiansheng had to hold back as he was the trump card to deal with the traitor. Otherwise, the traitor would be given a chance to observe and react accordingly after seeing the trump card.
Su Yu was feeling very helpless. He was only a white mask, not the true master of the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion. He could only follow his orders or he might endanger even himself.
